items.note: The line shows only a store department code; no rule can be applied to an unknown item.

items.name: service dog training fee
items.note: Costs of buying, training and maintaining a guide dog or other service animal, including food and veterinary care, are includible.

items.name: standard wheelchair, 18 in seat
items.note: A wheelchair used for relief of sickness or disability is includible, as is its upkeep.

items.name: flexible fabric adhesive bandages, 30 count
items.note: Medical supplies such as bandages are includible.

items.name: swimming lessons, 4 weeks
items.note: Dancing or swimming lessons for general health aren't includible, even if a doctor recommends them.

items.name: boneless chicken breast, 2 lb
items.note: Food that is normally consumed to satisfy nutritional needs isn't medical care.

items.name: percussion massage gun
items.note: Devices that relieve general physical discomfort not related to a medical condition aren't medical care.

items.name: paper medical tape, 1 in
items.note: Medical supplies such as bandages are includible.

items.name: naproxen sodium 220 mg, 24 count
items.note: OTC medicines are medical care for FSAs and HRAs whether or not prescribed; CARES Act §3702 removed the prescription-only limit for expenses after 2019.

items.name: learning disability tutoring, 4 sessions
items.note: Tutoring by a specially trained teacher for a child's learning disability is includible when paid on a doctor's recommendation.
